# The engraver for sheet music (pianopipe's engrave.py): Verovio (LGPL-3.0) lays out the notation, resvg (MPL-2.0)
# draws it, Pillow (MIT-CMU) writes the page images. Native wheels with their libraries inside, for Python 3.12 on
# the workflow's Linux runner and on a Windows PC; `pip install -r .github/sheet-requirements.txt` works on either.
# Each is pinned by its sha256 (PyPI shows it). A change here engraves every level again.
